description: This file defines the Activity model class for the Opencart e-commerce platform, responsible for managing customer activity records in the database, including adding and deleting activities.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Model class for handling customer activity records, including methods to add and delete activities.

methods.name: addActivity
methods.description: Creates a new activity record in the database with key, data, customer ID, IP address, and timestamp.

methods.name: deleteActivities
methods.description: Deletes all activity records associated with a specific customer ID.
